Class ModelPack

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.ModelPack
final class ModelPack extends Object
A trained model as one file, to keep or to take to another game: /swordai export writes one to swordai/models, /swordai import puts one back. A pack holds the network and what goes with it (its settings, where its training has got to, the copies it trains against), and nothing else: no history, no backups, so that it stays a few megabytes.

    • importPack

      static int importPack(String name) throws IOException
      Makes the model in the pack of this name the current one. What it replaces is first written to the pack BEFORE_IMPORT, so an import can be taken back by importing that. Files the pack does not have are left as they are, except the network itself, which every pack has.
      Returns:
      how many files were put in place
      Throws:
      IOException
